#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
prompt=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.prompt // empty')

# Detect spec-kit commands and inject guidance
if [[ "$prompt" == */speckit.plan* ]]; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "PLAN PHASE: Include Claude Code Execution Architecture section. Define agent specializations (solution-architect/Opus, backend-developer/Sonnet, test-engineer/Sonnet, security-auditor/Haiku). Identify parallel execution boundaries. Define context management thresholds. Specify quality gate hooks. Read .claude/skills/dotnet-plan-strategy.md if available."}}'
elif [[ "$prompt" == */speckit.tasks* ]]; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "TASKS PHASE: Add execution metadata to each task (depends_on, blocks, parallel_group, recommended_agent, model_tier, background_eligible). Organize into execution waves. Mark [P] for parallel tasks. Include dependency graph. Read .claude/skills/dotnet-task-parallelization.md if available."}}'
elif [[ "$prompt" == */speckit.implement* ]]; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "IMPLEMENT PHASE: Execute wave-by-wave. Spawn parallel sub-agents for [P] tasks using & operator. Use Ctrl+B for background tasks. Create checkpoints at wave boundaries. Enforce test-first. Initialize TodoWrite for progress tracking. Read .claude/skills/dotnet-implementation-execution.md if available."}}'
elif [[ "$prompt" == */speckit.analyze* ]]; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "ANALYZE PHASE: Run parallel analysis streams. Use solution-architect for constitutional compliance. Use code-reviewer for spec-plan alignment. Use security-auditor for security analysis. Aggregate findings by severity."}}'
elif [[ "$prompt" == */speckit.checklist* ]]; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "CHECKLIST PHASE: Execute automated gates (dotnet format, dotnet build --warnaserror, code coverage). Use security-auditor and code-reviewer agents for validation. Generate PASS/FAIL report."}}'
fi

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
file_path=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty')

if [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(cs|razor)$ ]]; then
  if command -v dotnet &> /dev/null; then
    result=$(dotnet format --include "$file_path" --verify-no-changes 2>&1) || echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Format check: File needs formatting. Run 'dotnet format' to fix.\"}"
  fi
fi

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
command=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')

# Block dangerous commands
if echo "$command" | grep -qE 'rm\s+-rf\s+/|rm\s+-rf\s+\.|DROP\s+DATABASE|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|git\s+push.*--force'; then
  echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "BLOCKED: Potentially destructive command detected. Please confirm this is intentional."}}' >&2
  exit 2
fi

#!/bin/bash
# Check if there are uncommitted test files that might indicate incomplete TDD
if [ -d "tests" ] || [ -d "Tests" ]; then
  pending=$(find . -name "*Tests.cs" -newer .git/index 2>/dev/null | head -5)
  if [ -n "$pending" ]; then
    echo '{"systemMessage": "Reminder: New test files detected. Ensure all tests pass before completing this task."}'
  fi
fi
